# Load Data
the code below loads up data and has the age exclusions and excludes data that is not valuable 

```{r processedGermanTokens}
German_tokens <- read_csv("C:/Spanish Folder/processed_data/German_tokens.csv")

```
this takes the processed data and creates the sum of frequency per speaker role at each age, and then divide and then create parts per thousand, leading to the cumalative sums 
take a0 for each zero in each function word for each age bin between the ages of 0 and 10
add in the rows from 0 to 10 for the function word real freq so that it shows that the data here is 0 

ask if this code is necessary

```{r}
logical_relfreq <-
  German_tokens %>%
  group_by(logical, target_child_age, speaker_role) %>%
  summarise(freq=n()) %>%
  group_by(speaker_role, target_child_name) %>%
  mutate(total=sum(freq), relfreq=freq/sum(freq), pct=relfreq*100) %>%
  group_by(logical, speaker_role) %>%
  arrange(target_child_age) %>%
  mutate(cum_freq = cumsum(freq), cum_total= cumsum(total), cumulative_relfreq = cumsum(freq)/cumsum(total), cumulative_pct=cumulative_relfreq*100)

saveRDS(logical_relfreq, "logical_relfreq.RDS")
```

this chunk of code creates another data frame that calculates the cumalative relative frequency of each of the words in the logical words and sorts them by speaker age
# stan is not comiling so forcing data may be a problem...
these function words include: 
```{r}
functionword_relfreq <-
  
  child_data <- German_tokens %>%
  filter(speaker_role == "Target_Child") %>%
  mutate(target_child_age = floor(target_child_age)) %>%  # only change
  group_by(gloss, target_child_age, speaker_role) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(freq = as.numeric(freq)) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    gloss,
    speaker_role,
    target_child_age = 0:10,
    
    fill = list(freq = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(freq = ifelse(target_child_age <= 10, 0, freq))


parent_data <- German_tokens %>%
  filter(speaker_role != "Target_Child") %>%
  mutate(target_child_age = floor(target_child_age)) %>%  # only change
  group_by(gloss, target_child_age, speaker_role) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(freq = as.numeric(freq))

functionword_relfreq <- bind_rows(child_data, parent_data) %>%
  group_by(speaker_role, target_child_age) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(freq),
    relfreq = ifelse(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
    ppt = relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  group_by(gloss, speaker_role) %>%
  arrange(target_child_age) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = ifelse(cum_total == 0, 1e-6, cum_freq / cum_total),
    cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000
  )

  saveRDS(functionword_relfreq, "functionword_relfreq.RDS")

```

#Have a graph that has the curves for all of these words, 
#Have a big growth curves with all the different negation words across the different langauges 


```{r Neg_No_Growth_Model, include=FALSE}
neg_nein_lagModel <- brm(
 
  bf(
    cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote * exp(
      -exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) * (lag - target_child_age) + 1)
    ),
    upperAsymptote ~ 1,
    growthRate ~ 1,
    lag ~ 1,
    nl = TRUE
  ),
  
  data = filter(
    functionword_relfreq,
    gloss == "nein",
    speaker_role == "Target_Child"
    
  ),
  
  #this is often what you have to change
 
  prior = c(
    prior(uniform(0, 80), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = 80),
    prior(uniform(0, 20), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 20),
    prior(uniform(0, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 0, ub = 72)
  ),

  iter = 10000,
  file = "German_neg_nein_lag_model_fit21"
)


```


this is calculating the age of production for the curve 
this also helps set the age boundaries for the bayesian model

```{r age_of_production_nein}


summ <- fixef(neg_nein_lagModel)

age_of_production_nein <- data.frame(
  gloss = "nein",
  Estimate  = round(summ["lag_Intercept", "Estimate"], 1),
  Est.Error = round(summ["lag_Intercept", "Est.Error"], 1),
  Q2.5      = round(summ["lag_Intercept", "Q2.5"], 1),
  Q97.5     = round(summ["lag_Intercept", "Q97.5"], 1)
)

saveRDS(age_of_production_nein, "../processed_data/age_of_production_nein.RDS")

```


fits it into the model 

```{r neg_nein_predictions}
neg_nein_predictions <- as.data.frame(fitted(neg_nein_lagModel))

neg_nein_childdata <- filter(functionword_relfreq, gloss == "nein", speaker_role=="Target_Child")
neg_nein_childdata$predictions <- neg_nein_predictions[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(neg_nein_childdata, "../processed_data/neg_neinGerman_childdata.RDS")
```

this code plots the graph of the cumalative relative frequency of child age per month versus parts per thousand e 
```{r neg_nein_prediction_Plot} 
nein_plot <-
  ggplot(neg_nein_childdata, aes(x = target_child_age, y = cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = "Actual Data"), size = 2) + # Original data points
  geom_line(aes(y = predictions, color = "Fitted Values"), size = 1) + # Fitted values
  scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c("Actual Data" = "black", "Fitted Values" = "blue")) +
  theme_bw() + labs(title="Nein", x="Child Age (Month)", y="Parts per Thousand") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") +   
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(linewidth = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(linewidth= 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(linewidth = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(linewidth= 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(linewidth= 14),
    legend.title = element_text(linewidth = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(linewidth = 12)
  )

print(nein_plot)
```

#combined age of production
```{r}
age_of_production <-
  bind_rows(age_of_production_nein,
            age_of_production_nicht,
            age_of_production_kein) %>%
  mutate(gloss = fct_reorder(gloss, Estimate),
         Estimate = as.numeric(Estimate),
         Q2.5 = as.numeric(Q2.5),
         Q97.5 = as.numeric(Q97.5))

saveRDS(age_of_production, "../processed_data/age_of_production_german.RDS")
```

```{r}
age_of_production <- readRDS("../processed_data/age_of_production_german.RDS")

functionword_onsetage_plot <-
  age_of_production %>%
  mutate(gloss = fct_reorder(gloss, Estimate)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Estimate, y=gloss)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12), xlab="age") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 3)) +
  labs(x = "Age (Months)", y="") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))

print(functionword_onsetage_plot)
```


```{r}
# Read all three
nein  <- readRDS("../processed_data/age_of_production_nein.RDS")
nicht <- readRDS("../processed_data/age_of_production_nicht.RDS")
kein  <- readRDS("../processed_data/age_of_production_kein.RDS")

# Combine and plot
bind_rows(nein, nicht, kein) %>%
  mutate(gloss = fct_reorder(gloss, Estimate)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = gloss)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 3)) +
  labs(x = "Age (Months)", y = "")

```
